app.title: Back Through 10

intro.title: Learn it: back through 10!
intro.say: Let’s learn to take away back through ten. Take away to get back to ten first, then take the rest. Tap Start.

stories: Ava has {a} stickers. Ava gives {b} to Leo. How many stickers are left?
{a} crabs sit on a rock. {b} crabs scuttle away. How many crabs are left?
Sam has {a} shells. A wave takes {b} away. How many shells are left?
Mia bakes {a} lamingtons. The family eats {b}. How many lamingtons are left?
{a} boats are in the cove. {b} boats sail away. How many boats are left?
Kai has {a} gold coins. Kai spends {b}. How many gold coins are left?
Zoe picks {a} apples. Zoe gives {b} to Ben. How many apples are left?
{a} gulls sit on the pier. {b} gulls fly off. How many gulls are left?
Noah has {a} pebbles. Noah drops {b} in the sea. How many pebbles are left?
Ruby has {a} pegs. Ivy borrows {b}. How many pegs are left?
